summary: The change stops the analyzer from crashing on invalid contracts in [MessagePackObject(SuppressSourceGeneration = true)] types: duplicate-key members no longer throw from Dictionary.Add, and mixed int/string key members are reported and skipped instead of dereferencing a null key value. Contract diagnostics (missing [Key], duplicate keys, mixed key kinds, non-public member, member type) are still reported for suppressed types, while generation-only diagnostics (partial-class, AOT checks) remain unreported because GetObjectInfo returns early once source generation is suppressed. All 175 analyzer tests pass with no regressions, and 4 of the 8 new analyzer tests fail on base source with analyzer exceptions (AD0001), demonstrating the fix covers the change.

requirement_verdicts.confidence_basis: On head the analyzer reports missing-key, duplicate-key and mixed-key-kind diagnostics for suppressed types and all six contract tests pass; the four crash-related tests fail on base source with analyzer exceptions, showing the fix addresses the root cause (crash on invalid contracts) rather than a symptom. Parity with version 3.1.0 could not be independently verified because no 3.1.0 evidence was provided.

findings.title: Duplicate-key diagnostic reports only one diagnostic although two members share the key
findings.claim: For duplicate keys the code reports KeysMustBeUnique only on the second member and then skips adding it, so the first member remains in the dictionary; users see one diagnostic instead of being told both members collide. This matches the tests' expectations but may under-report the contract problem.
findings.suggested_fix: Consider whether both members should be flagged; no code change required unless the product owner wants the first member reported too.

findings.title: New test file triggers StyleCop SA1649 warning
findings.claim: SuppressedSourceGenerationTests.cs contains two public types but the file name matches neither, producing warning SA1649 in both ExecutionTests projects.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename the file to SuppressedSourceGenerationType.cs or split the types into separate files.

findings.title: Runtime execution tests do not demonstrate the fix
findings.claim: SuppressedSourceGenerationTests round-trip and formatter-absence tests pass on base source as well, so they add regression coverage but not fix coverage; REQ-2234-N2 is satisfied by the analyzer tests instead.

findings.title: README documents behavior accurately
findings.claim: README additions describe which diagnostics are and are not reported for suppressed types, matching the code's early-return behavior.
